facts.label: reported
facts.quote: MCX gold has fallen around 13% so far this month, while silver has plunged nearly 20%, extending losses after a strong rally over the past year.
facts.text: Gold prices on India's Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) fell by around 13 percent in November 2026, while silver dropped by nearly 20 percent.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Silver futures on the MCX crashed another ₹8,800 per kg to ₹1,36,712, their lowest level since September 2025.
facts.text: MCX silver futures sank to 1,36,712 rupees per kilogram, marking their lowest price level since September 2025.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: “The pullback reflects a firmer US dollar and rising bond yields after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, lifting market expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike to nearly 90%,” explained Rajeev Sharan, Head of Research, Brickwork Ratings.
facts.text: Market expectations for a US Federal Reserve interest rate hike reached nearly 90 percent after October inflation figures came in higher than anticipated.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: He said managed-money positions in Comex metals had declined by around $20 billion since October, partly as investors raised funds to cover losses in other asset classes, including AI-related investments.
facts.text: Institutional money managers liquidated roughly 20 billion US dollars in Comex metals positions after October to cover liquidity demands in equity and tech holdings.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: Silver also tends to fall harder than gold on the same news, because its market is smaller.
facts.text: Silver prices experience significantly steeper drops than gold during market pullbacks because the silver market has smaller liquidity and lower overall size.

intro.prompt: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, about 8 seconds, photorealistic and cinematic, bright vivid colour. Setting: close view of an Indian jewellery showroom glass counter, rows of heavy gold bangles and necklaces glowing under warm spotlights, the counter empty of customers, evening, natural shop light. Time of day and light, overriding anything darker in the setting above: bright golden-hour sunlight or clear daylight, a blue or golden sky, warm saturated colours, his face and clothes fully lit; never night, dusk, storm clouds, lightning, fog, grey overcast, a dark or desaturated look. The background is real and in motion behind him (as fits the place: waves, mist, leaves, flags, lamps flickering, people walking, traffic, light shifting); never a still, flat or heavily blurred backdrop. Movement and framing: like a TV news reporter on location, he walks toward the camera while he speaks: he starts three or four steps back, seen from the knees up, walks steadily and confidently toward the lens, and stops at a medium shot from the waist up for the last words. His whole head and both shoulders stay inside the frame the whole time, with clear space above his hair and on both sides; do not crop the top of his head. Lighting: warm key light on the face, a soft rim light on the hair, matched to the scene; flattering, no harsh shadows, no dull or flat grey look. SG [locked] walking tall and lively, shoulders open, energetic and confident, wearing a tan blazer over a pale pink shirt. His forehead is clean and bare: no tilak, no bindi, no vermilion or sandal-paste mark, no dot or line of any colour on his face. Speaks from the first frame, mouth matched to the words, steady eye contact with the lens. Face and delivery: an excited, high-energy presenter breaking a big story, full of life, as if he cannot wait to tell you. Bright, wide-awake eyes, lively eyebrows that lift on the question, a big, bright, genuine smile. On the question his voice rises with excitement as he strides closer. On the last line a big confident smile, a quick nod and a point at the viewer. Natural blinking, lively head movement. Never sad, gloomy, worried, tired, sleepy, flat or bored; never a frown, never a blank face. Voice: energetic, upbeat, punchy and clear, a brisk pace, rising on the question, with a quick beat before the last line. Hands: energetic, natural gestures at chest height: a quick point toward the scene behind him on the question and an open palm toward the viewer on the last line; never limp, never hanging still by his sides. Camera: eye level, steady, holding its place as he walks up to it (a very slight slow push-in at most), slight handheld feel. Empty hands, no prop. @SGLearning watermark in the top right corner, white, bold, 80% opacity. No captions, no subtitles, no other on-screen text. No hologram, no floating screen, no graph, no chart, no laptop, tablet, monitor, TV or glowing blue panel anywhere in the frame. Export at 1080x1920.
